defuss-shadcn / Introduction / index

A UI component system
that scales with AI.

Themeable, stateful components, built on semantic HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. No framework. No build step for consumers - dist/ is committed and ready to use as-is. A foundation for agentic-first frontend engineering.

Built using Verified Agentic Engineering (VAE)

13 commit messages
  • build: regenerate dist, the skills copy and the stat figures for the load() review fixes
  • fix(graph-explorer): the outline filter reset selects through df$
  • test(e2e): graph-explorer-data covers every refusal, the first load, races, resets and the bounds

  • fix(graph-explorer): a navigation during load() ends; load() clears search and outline filter; a superseded load() resolves false
  • fix(graph-explorer): a node's incoming links scan the sibling ranges in place
  • fix(graph-explorer): load() refuses holey name lists, SharedArrayBuffer arrays, clusters of more than 1,024 children and more than 256 levels
  • build: regenerate dist, the skills copy, What's new and the stat figures for load()
  • docs(graph-explorer): keep the transfer claim to what the e2e shows; the label copy cost is UNKNOWN
  • test(e2e): graph-explorer-data - a page's graph in the explorer
  • docs(graph-explorer): Your own graph - a code base loaded from the page
  • feat(graph-explorer): load() a page's graph (GraphExplorerData, data-source="external")
  • test(e2e): wait for lazily booted example previews (shared exampleFrame helper) and poll the Studio canvas after a WebKit drop - both flaked under load during the v0.9.18 release

  • feat(chat): Component Schema + Chat Components + Chat Scripts - chats ask with cards (fields, currency, questionnaires with Other, plans, quick replies; typed answers, validation by JSON path, ui::component-schema fences and a show_components tool), scripted conversations without a model; AI Chat: Examples group (also for stores from earlier visits), cards in answers, the tool in API mode, script chats that follow their end, a light/dark Swap in the sidebar; fix(session): an appended row renders at its real size, a row removed under an anchored turn keeps the reader in place, scrollToEnd/Start end the anchor hold; questionnaire.test()

23 commit messages
  • chore: dist rebuilt for the terminal fix
  • fix(terminal): a failing xterm module names the load failure - the stylesheet's error raced it
  • chore(agents): updated agent memory after self-reflection
  • fix(build): Finder's .DS_Store stays out of dist/ - the section flatten read one as a component folder (ENOTDIR)
  • chore(build): screenshots are taken by hand - make build, deploy.sh and verify no longer take or check them; dist 1:1 skips Finder's .DS_Store
  • fix(whats-new): a released version lists its pages in the changelog and its commits in the dialog - the record keys 0.9.14, the changelog v0.9.14
  • chore(agents): the docs search, What's new, the Terminal and the Language Switcher in AGENTS.md
  • chore: docs, nav, generated skills and dist for the new components, the docs search and What's new
  • docs(guides): Design Language - which component for which use case, a decision tree and a use-case index
  • fix(diagram): a setState naming the state already shown draws nothing - the flagship deck stalled ~600 ms on every slide change
  • feat(tabs): a link to something inside a hidden panel selects that panel's tab
  • fix(shader): no more wobble - the quality scale holds once it fell back after a raise; only shaders in view draw, the gallery is a carousel
  • feat(carousel): several slides in view - Prev / Next move by a page, a counter reads the slides shown
  • feat(heading-anchor): the anchor in front of, before or after the heading text, with # instead of §
  • feat(border-layout): several Panels in one region - a stack with dividers, side by side or top to bottom, one open at a time with data-exclusive
  • feat(graph-explorer): layers of information as filters, Live mode with an updates outlet, a neighbour ring; the Knowledge Graph's Hierarchy Explorer, Updates and Back / Out, without the flicker
  • fix(sidebar): the section headers' chevrons sit at the right edge again - a hidden What's new dot took their slot
  • feat(docs): What's new - the pages each release created or updated, derived from git; dots in the sidebar, a dialog on the front page and a note on each changed page until it is opened
  • feat(website): eight industry sites, and every site works end to end - each listed item opens a page of its own, every link has a destination, a Language Switcher on every template, the Developer portfolio's hero a live terminal
  • feat(language-switcher): Language Switcher - a Combobox, Swap or menu of languages with flags and names from Intl; every Application Scaffold switches its language through one
  • feat(terminal): Terminal - a live command line on xterm.js 6 with a shell of its own (prompt, history, completion, commands, replayed sessions); the Desktop's Command Prompt runs on it
  • feat(command): data-filter="none" - the page writes the items from its own search, the palette keeps its keys, highlight and Enter
  • feat(docs): the palette searches with defuss-search - BM25 fused with Winzling-reranker's ColBERT scan over an index built from the rendered pages; the model loads after the page and is cached, defuss-lid reads the query's language

Websites

Whole websites made of the components and the website blocks, each with a full-screen page: routed and translated templates in three looks, portfolio styles, showcase sites and eight industry sites with their own palettes, typefaces and shaders.

All websites →

Themeable

Full shadcn semantic token model. 43 tweakcn presets ship as drop-in theme files - swap one and every component updates instantly; light and dark are two palettes of one identity (the same radius in both, gated).

Design your own theme →

Component Skills

Every component ships a structured skill, every interactive one also a *.schema.json contract. Install skills/defuss-shadcn/SKILL.md in your agent - it carries every component skill with it. Three task skills plan UI, write themes and review markup, with bundled checkers.

Component Skills →

Observable state

Interactive components expose a State API (el.api.setState('open')), so agents and tests can drive every documented state by name - each component's end-to-end test asserts every one of its states, and bun run screenshots renders them in light and dark when a change needs a look.

State API guide →

Accessible

Built on native HTML elements and WAI-ARIA patterns (menus and menubars with nested submenus, tabs, dialogs, trees, comboboxes, one-time-code fields, virtualized lists, map regions walked and picked by keyboard, workflow ports connected by keyboard). Keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader support by default - and every theme preset's nav text is contrast-gated (WCAG AA) by verify.

Accessibility guide →

Standalone HTML

Plain HTML, CSS and ES modules - no framework, no build pipeline, and 180 of 272 components need no JavaScript at all. The interactive ones run on one tiny core runtime, df$: defuss-query for DOM selection and events and defuss-morph for HTML reconciling, plus the shared State API helpers - shipped once as core.js, inside all.js. The footprint (counts per type, JS/CSS-only split, byte sizes) is published as dist/stats.json.

JavaScript Modules guide →
